nodes.title: style
widgets_values: Dark, gothic, cinematic orchestral theme for a vampire film, slow and hypnotic at 74 BPM in 4/4, retaining the original melodic character and harmonic progression of Bbmaj7, Gm, Bb and Cm. Haunting, melancholic and subtly seductive atmosphere, with a distinctly English gothic romanticism reminiscent of classic Hammer Horror film scores. A beautiful, expressive female solo vocalist with a somewhat operatic, classically trained soprano voice, ethereal and haunting, with rich vibrato, sustained high notes, delicate ornamentation and dramatic melodic phrasing. The vocal should feel intimate yet theatrical, somewhere between a ghostly lullaby and a tragic operatic aria, occasionally soft and breathy before opening into powerful soaring phrases. Clear English diction, with an elegant, slightly old-fashioned delivery. Sparse verses with plenty of space between vocal phrases, building into an emotionally sweeping and memorable chorus. Underneath, dark minor-tinged piano chords, delicate harpsichord accents, deep resonant cello and double bass, haunting legato violins, subtle tremolo strings, atmospheric orchestral pads and occasional dissonant string swells. Gentle low percussion and restrained timpani accents, never a modern pop or rock beat. Gradually evolving orchestral arrangement, alternating between intimate passages and dramatic cinematic crescendos, with a particularly haunting bridge and a final operatic vocal climax before fading into a cold, unresolved gothic atmosphere. Elegant, sinister, romantic, mysterious and tragic, evoking an ancient English manor, moonlit corridors, forbidden desire and the approach of dawn. A timeless gothic horror soundtrack rather than contemporary horror music.

widgets_values:
# FIRST BLOOD

[Verse 1]
Two shadows waiting in the hall  
A velvet whisper, a whispered call  
Their eyes were black, their lips were red  
They smiled and beckoned me to bed  

[Verse 2]
A silver moon, a candle's flame  
They softly spoke my secret name  
One held my hand, one kissed my throat  
I felt the darkness take its hold  

[Chorus]
First blood, first blood  
A crimson kiss beneath the moon  
First blood, first blood  
The night would end, and far too soon  

[Verse 3]
I ran through corridors of stone  
Barefoot, breathless, all alone  
The great doors opened to the day  
I stumbled out and fled away  

[Verse 4]
The morning light upon the lawn  
The old house waking with the dawn  
I thought I'd won, I thought I'd flown  
But I was never quite alone  

[Chorus]
First blood, first blood  
A crimson kiss beneath the moon  
First blood, first blood  
The night would end, and far too soon  

[Bridge]
Two figures standing in the light  
Still beautiful, still dressed in night  
A hand upon me, cold as snow  
And back into the dark I go  

[Final Chorus]
First blood, first blood  
The final kiss, the final plea  
First blood, first blood  
The dawn has come, but not for me  

[Outro]
The doors close slowly  
The candles die  
Two shadows smiling  
And no goodbye

widgets_values:
The cover feature works by using these nodes to convert an audio file to ABC music notation and then feeding it to the Yue2 Generate Music node.

If extending or rewriting something its worth giving the original audio and Yue-2 ABC notation output to ChatGPT or a big LLM to analyse and extend.

NOTE: YUE-2 has a stripped down form of ABC Notation.

# MarkDKBerry.com

YUE-2 Links

basics on comfyui of what you can do with it [https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/audio/yue2/yue2](https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/audio/yue2/yue2)

## CONVERT TO ABC NOTATION

YUE-2 uses a stripped down version of ABC notation in this model. You can use this to convert whatever you have to something it can digest:

- YUE-2 ABC notation guide is here [https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/blob/main/skills/yue2-music/references/abc-editing.md](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/blob/main/skills/yue2-music/references/abc-editing.md)

---

## EXAMPLE PROMPTS & SETTINGS FOR COVERS:

taken from u/LilBrownBebeShoes on reddit recommendations:

1. `English, energetic and polished male baritone vocal with a pop-rock edge, early 2000s pop-punk power-pop, crunchy distorted rhythm guitars, vibrant lead guitar hooks, punchy acoustic drums, prominent melodic bass lines, infectious and anthemic rock atmosphere`
	- ABC Mode Full, Generate Mode Full, Generate CFG 1.2, temp 0.80, top_p 0.95, top_k 100, rep_penalty 1.20, Sampler CFG 1, Steps 64, DPM_2, sgm_uniform
</br>

2. `English, breathy, cinematic female vocal with a vintage, melancholic tone, orchestral dream-pop and slow-burn noir ballad, lush string section, reverb-drenched electric guitar, warm vinyl crackle, subtle slow-tempo percussion, haunting and nostalgic atmosphere`	
	- ABC Mode Full, Generate Mode Full,Generate CFG 2.0, temp 0.90,top_p 0.95,top_k 100,rep_penalty 1.20,Sampler CFG 1,Steps 64,DPM_2,sgm_uniform
</br>

3. `English, gritty and emotionally charged male vocal with raw rock texture, mid-2000s post-grunge electro-exotic rock fusion, fast-paced 135 BPM driving groove, wall-of-sound distorted electric guitars and massive layered choruses, pulsing synth bass, middle-eastern inspired electric sitar motifs, energetic electronic percussion layered with heavy acoustic drums, dramatic and aggressive high-energy atmosphere`
</br>

4. `English, intimate and emotionally rich female vocal, dramatic piano ballad, warm grand piano, subtle ambient synth textures, delicate cello, cinematic orchestral strings, gentle acoustic percussion, melancholic and deeply expressive atmosphere`
